proposals.evidence: DEDR5482 gives Telugu veṇḍruka ‘a hair’, plural -lu ‘hairs, the hair’. Survey veṇṭrukalu is that plural formation with the stop-voicing difference retained; the current parent’s uncertain reconstruction is not upgraded to certainty. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
